title: Data Center Power Yard: 14 Modular Power Units
scope: Prefabricated power modules (e-houses) set on piled pads, with transformers and MV cable trench. Repetitive sequence driven by a module-setting rate.
assume: 14 power modules 11 m × 5.5 m on 600 mm pads over 8 bored piles each; 2,500 kVA pad-mount transformer per module.
Rigging: crane sets one module per 5 working days per crew.
Energization shown as status: cyan = terminations/testing, green = energized.
